items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: I was going to work with Rip like I worked with Cosimo or Joe Asanto.

ctx.x: Yeah. Rip had a club. What was the name of it? San Jacinto was the name of the club. San Jacinto? Yeah.

Oh the San Jacinto club. Yeah. That's when he was booking, well he was booking big acts for Wake. Yeah I know Roberts used to book pretty big acts in town. Yeah. But I was going to do some session with Rip. I was going to work with Rip like I worked with Cosimo or Joe Asanto.
